desc.zh: 视野 3×3：看得见身边一圈的 8 个格子。
desc.en: Vision 3×3: it sees the ring of 8 cells around it.

robot-scout.look:
<g class="bot"><path class="bot-ant" d="M16 2.5V7"/><circle class="bot-lamp" cx="16" cy="2.6" r="2.2"/>
      <rect class="bot-head" x="5" y="7" width="22" height="16" rx="5"/>
      <circle class="bot-eye" cx="11.5" cy="15" r="2.4"/><circle class="bot-eye" cx="20.5" cy="15" r="2.4"/>
      <rect class="bot-base" x="8" y="24" width="16" height="5" rx="2.5"/></g>

desc.zh: 视野升级到 5×5，看得见身边两圈、24 个格子；还看得见表头上的两个词，也会换方向扫：倒着扫、按长度扫。
desc.en: Vision upgraded to 5×5, two rings around it, 24 cells; it also sees the two words along a table’s edges, and it can scan another way: backwards, or by length.

robot-ranger.look:
<g class="bot"><path class="bot-ant" d="M10 7L7 2M22 7L25 2"/><circle class="bot-lamp" cx="7" cy="2.4" r="1.8"/><circle class="bot-lamp" cx="25" cy="2.4" r="1.8"/>
      <rect class="bot-head" x="4" y="6" width="24" height="17" rx="4"/>
      <rect class="bot-visor" x="6.5" y="11" width="19" height="6.5" rx="3.2"/>
      <circle class="bot-eye-l" cx="12" cy="14.2" r="1.9"/><circle class="bot-eye-l" cx="20" cy="14.2" r="1.9"/>
      <rect class="bot-base" x="5" y="24" width="22" height="5.5" rx="2.7"/><path class="bot-tread" d="M9 26.7H23"/></g>

desc.zh: 视野 5×5，还多了一条伸缩臂：能往回伸出这一格写着的那么多格，读到视野外面的格子。
desc.en: Vision 5×5, plus a telescopic arm: it reaches back by as many cells as this cell says, and reads cells outside its view.

robot-reach.look:
<g class="bot"><path class="bot-ant" d="M20 2.5V7"/><circle class="bot-lamp" cx="20" cy="2.6" r="2.2"/>
      <rect class="bot-head" x="10" y="7" width="20" height="15" rx="5"/>
      <circle class="bot-eye" cx="16" cy="14.5" r="2.3"/><circle class="bot-eye" cx="24" cy="14.5" r="2.3"/>
      <path class="bot-arm" d="M11 18H4.5V11.5"/><path class="bot-claw" d="M2 9.5L4.5 11.5L7 9.5"/>
      <rect class="bot-base" x="12" y="23.5" width="16" height="5.5" rx="2.7"/></g>

desc.zh: 视野 3×3，还带一条扫描臂：一次扫过一整段格子，把整段的数一起送进电路板，段里有几格都行。
desc.en: Vision 3×3, plus a sweep arm: it sweeps a whole run of cells in one go and feeds every number in the run into the circuit board, however many cells the run has.

robot-broom.look:
<g class="bot"><path class="bot-ant" d="M16 2.5V7"/><circle class="bot-lamp" cx="16" cy="2.6" r="2.2"/>
      <rect class="bot-head" x="8" y="7" width="20" height="15" rx="5"/>
      <circle class="bot-eye" cx="14" cy="14.5" r="2.2"/><circle class="bot-eye" cx="22" cy="14.5" r="2.2"/>
      <path class="bot-arm" d="M8.5 19H2.5"/><path class="bot-claw" d="M1.5 15V23M4 15V23"/>
      <rect class="bot-base" x="10" y="23.5" width="16" height="5.5" rx="2.7"/></g>

desc.zh: 视野 3×3，会一轮一轮地扫：读到还没算的格子先用上一轮的值，扫到整张表不再变才停下。
desc.en: Vision 3×3, and it scans in rounds: a cell not worked out yet reads its value from the last round, and it stops once a whole round changes nothing.

robot-loop.look:
<g class="bot"><path class="bot-ant" d="M11.5 6.6a4.6 4.6 0 1 1 9 0"/><path class="bot-ant" d="M20.5 6.6l2.2-2.4M20.5 6.6l-3-.2"/>
      <rect class="bot-head" x="5" y="7" width="22" height="16" rx="8"/>
      <circle class="bot-eye" cx="11.5" cy="15" r="2.4"/><circle class="bot-eye" cx="20.5" cy="15" r="2.4"/>
      <rect class="bot-base" x="8" y="24" width="16" height="5" rx="2.5"/></g>

desc.zh: 能同时站在很多层上：表有几层，它就在每一层的同一格上各算一次。每一层都有 3×3 的视野；探针还能探到另一层的格子。
desc.en: It stands on many layers at once: however many layers the table has, it works once on the same cell of each. Every layer has a 3×3 view, and its probe reaches cells on another layer.
